relations.rationale: Both describe events during the same session but have no causal or evidential link.
Noor's arrival time has no bearing on whether she hummed the opening number.
Noor's arrival relative to Kai is unrelated to Ana's arrival relative to Kai.
Noor humming a song has no bearing on Rosa's height compared to Ana.
Noor humming the opening number under her breath is consistent with and supports the idea she was rehearsing her solo behind the curtain.
Kai being in the same class as Noor doesn't determine Noor's class relation to Hugo directly, but if Kai and Noor share a class, it doesn't preclude Noor and Hugo being different classes.
Class membership of Kai and Noor is unrelated to Ana's arrival time relative to Kai.
If Kai is in the same class as Noor, and Kai is not in the same class as Hugo, this is consistent, supporting that Noor and Hugo may also differ, but doesn't directly assert it.
Kai and Noor's class relationship has no bearing on Rosa's reminder about theater hours.
Kai's class relation to Noor doesn't affect whether Noor rehearsed her solo behind the curtain.
Hugo strolling in last is consistent with and supports him needing to apologize for being late due to traffic.
Hugo arriving last is consistent with him then setting his bag down, supporting the sequence of events.
Hugo's arrival order has no bearing on his height relative to Rosa.
Hugo arriving last doesn't determine class membership relations between Noor and Hugo.
Hugo arriving last directly supports that Ana arrived earlier than Hugo.
Hugo arriving last is consistent with him later practicing his lines, supporting the sequence but not proving it.
Hugo setting his bag down near the piano has no bearing on Rosa checking her watch.
Hugo setting his bag down is unrelated to the stage lights dimming at the end of rehearsal.
Rosa being taller than Hugo doesn't inherently establish her height relative to Ana.
Rosa's height relative to Hugo has no bearing on whether she adjusted the lighting rig.
